tagline: Innovative eye care solutions combining imaging, cloud, and AI for enhanced diagnostic pathways
hero_kpi_rationale: The 'AI Cloud Mix' KPI is the hero because it captures the growing adoption of the iCare ILLUME solution, which combines ocular imaging, cloud, and AI for screening, a key differentiating offering in the connected diagnostics segment.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from the sale of ophthalmic devices and solutions.
kpis.description: Revenue is growing driven by strong demand for fundus imaging devices and tonometers, particularly in the US and EMEA regions.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by net sales.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined slightly over six months due to a 0.73 M€ depreciation related to the Ventica product, which is non-strategic.
kpis.signal: Adjusted margin at 22.7% despite non-recurring amortization

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin after cost of sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains stable around 71%, reflecting the quality and technical sophistication of products sold.
kpis.signal: High rate, typical of high-value-add medical device models

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA grew over six months, supported by improved net results and efficient working capital management.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Average number of employees during the period.
kpis.description: Average headcount increased by 9 employees year-over-year, reflecting strengthening of operational and R&D teams.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth supporting innovation and expansion

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow increased significantly driven by improved net results and better working capital management.
kpis.signal: Very strong operating cash flow, rising from 0.1 M€ to 11.2 M€

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.15 Bns € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.01 Bns € in the latest year

risks.title: Cybersecurity and sensitive data breaches
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in the document with strong language (notable financial consequences). It is positioned ahead of other business risks. The trend is stable, but the risk is recurring in the medical technology sector. The category is critical due to the nature of data involved (health).

risks.title: Product quality and delivery dependence
risks.score_rationale: The document cites notable delivery or product quality issues as a potential source of reputational damage. The language is moderate but the risk is directly tied to core business operations. Trend is stable, medium impact.

risks.title: Competition in ophthalmic diagnostic solutions
risks.score_rationale: Although not explicitly named, Revenio's positioning as a global provider of diagnostic solutions implies intense competition. The sector is technology-driven and innovative, with elevated disruption risk. Trend is rising.

risks.title: Healthcare sector regulatory changes
risks.score_rationale: Changes in national legislation or political environment are cited as potential business impact drivers. The medical device sector is heavily regulated (CE, FDA, etc.). Language is cautious but risk is critical. Trend is stable.

risks.title: Cessation of operations in Russia and Belarus
risks.score_rationale: The cessation of operations in Russia and Belarus is mentioned as accomplished fact. The impact is limited (<2% of sales), but it illustrates geopolitical exposure. Trend is declining as this has already been realized.

risks.title: Dependence on technology innovation
risks.score_rationale: The medical diagnostics sector evolves rapidly. Revenio invests heavily in R&D (11.5% of sales). The risk of technology lag is implicit but critical. Trend is rising.

risks.title: Exposure to global pandemics
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions Covid-19 as a risk with direct and indirect effects. Language is moderate, but the risk is real for supply chain and sales. Trend is stable.

ai_positioning.summary: Revenio integrates AI as a key component of its iCare ILLUME solution, combining imaging, cloud, and artificial intelligence to enhance ocular screening. AI is not a standalone product but rather a lever for clinical efficiency.
evidence: iCare ILLUME combines DRSplus imaging, cloud, and AI for screening
Solution actively presented at industry conferences with very positive feedback
Commercial expansion in Europe and the Middle East based on this differentiating offering
